pages.title: Cryocooler Unit
pages.text: A closed-cycle superfluid refrigerator. It pumps heat out of a superconducting magnet and keeps it below its critical temperature, without which the superconductor would stop superconducting. It frosts over in seconds and makes a soft, steady sigh.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)My magnets kept quenching. In the Bose-Einstein Condenser, I built a cycle where superfluid helium flowed between Casimir Plates, carrying heat out without friction. I later found a few in derelict stations.

Made in $(item)Bose-Einstein Condenser$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Cryogenics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Asymmetric Reactor, Cosmic Neutronium Coil Block, Cryogenic Cooling Jacket, Plasma Injection Nozzle, Spacetime Alloy Coil Block.
